get_agency_billing_payment_information_p.description: Count the orders that would be completed by a propagation, globally and per legal information. Only orders whose field is empty are counted : a value already set on an order is never overwritten. The scope is limited to the given order states and to the user's perimeter. The payment legal information only exists on French agencies : on any other agency this endpoint returns the `2133` error instead of counters.

mentions.description: Payment legal information codes (AFNOR XP Z12-012) to propagate. Allowed values : `PMD` (late payment penalties), `PMT` (recovery costs), `AAB` (discount).

states.description: List of order states `id` to include (described by /api/rest/application/dictionary/setting.state.order). Already invoiced orders are not excluded by the API : the scope is carried by the selected states.

sort.description: Order by a given column: turnoverInvoicedIncludingTax date reference turnoverInvoicedExcludingTax expectedPaymentDate state order.number order.project.reference order.project.company.name order.mainManager.lastName closed startDate endDate intermediaryCompany.name

keywords.description: If `keywords = FACTID1 BDCID2 PRJID3 CCONID4 CSOCID5` then invoices : of which unique identifier in [ID1] are filtered. with orders related to them, of which unique identifier in [ID2] are filtered. with projects related to them, of which unique identifier in [ID3] are filtered. with contacts related to them, of which unique identifier in [ID4] are filtered.

project_types.description: List of project types `id` to filter (described by /api/rest/application/dictionary/setting.typeOf.project)

payment_methods.description: List of payment methods `id` to filter (described by /api/rest/application/dictionary/setting.paymentMethod)

states.description: List of invoice states `id` to filter (described by /api/rest/application/dictionary/setting.state.invoice)

companies.description: List of companies `id` on which invoices item depends

closed.description: If `true` returns only invoices/credit notes which are closed, if `false` returns only invoices/credit notes which are not closed

credit_note.description: If `true` returns only credit notes, if `false` returns only bills

period.description: `created` : Invoices created between `startDate` and `endDate` are filtered `updated` : Invoices updated between `startDate` and `endDate` are filtered `expectedPayment` : Invoices whose expected payment's is between `startDate` and `endDate` are filtered `performedPayment` : Invoices whose performed payment's is between `startDate` and `endDate` are filtered `period` : Invoices whose period is between `startDate`

period_dynamic.description: `today` : Invoices filtered according to the grid for today's period `thisWeek` : Invoices filtered according to the mesh for the period of this week `thisMonth` : Invoices filtered according to the mesh for the period of this month `thisTrimester` : Invoices filtered according to the mesh for the period of this trimester `thisSemester` : Invoices filtered according to the mesh for the period of this semester

period_dynamic_parameters.description: Filter parameters of dynamic period. Used when periodDynamic is "lastCustomPeriod" or "nextCustomPeriod" You need two values separated by "," (duration,unit) eg (3,months) `1,n` : Duration of the custom period (max 100) `days,weeks,months,trimesters,semesters,years` : Unit of the custom period

amount_type.description: `equal` : Invoices `amountColumn` equal to `amount` `between` : Invoices `amountColumn` between `amountMin` and `amountMax`

amount_column.description: `totalExcludingTax` : Invoices amount filtered by `totalExcludingTax` column `totalIncludingTax` : Invoices amount filtered by `totalIncludingTax` column `totalPayableIncludingTax` : Invoices amount filtered by `totalPayableIncludingTax` column

flags.description: Invoices attached to this flag whom flag's unique identifier = integer are filtered

encoding.description: If the output format is csv then encoding filter should be one of : `UTF-8` `ISO-8859-15` `WINDOWS-1250` `MAC-OS-ROMAN`

extract_type.description: If the output format is csv then extractType filter should be one of : `detailed` `notDetailed`

get_invoicing_connections_callback.title: Get invoicing connections callback
get_invoicing_connections_callback.description: Endpoint the OAuth provider redirects the user back to after the consent screen. Exchanges the authorization code for access + refresh tokens, creates the InvoicingConnection record, then redirects the browser to the invoicing-connections administration page (`?status=success` or `?status=error&message=…`). On the very first hit (cross-site redirect from the provider), the session cookie may not be sent because of `SameSite=Strict`.

get_opportunity_ai_matching.title: Get opportunity ai matching
get_opportunity_ai_matching.description: Get list of profile matching this opportunity. Profiles already positioned on this opportunity are silently excluded, whatever the state of their positioning (end states included). They are removed before the search engines, so they get no score at all. Deleting the positioning makes the profile eligible again on the next run. Positionings on other opportunities never exclude.

scope.description: Restricts the searched population for the matching. `resources` searches only resources, `candidates` searches only candidates, `both` searches both (default). Honored only when the reranker feature flag is enabled; ignored otherwise.

updated_within.description: Restricts the matching to profiles whose last update date is within the given sliding window, applied identically to candidates and resources, before both retrieval engines. Windows are a fixed number of days (7 / 30 / 90 / 180 / 365), not calendar durations: `last365days` spans 365 days even on a leap year. The bound is taken at the start of the day, so a profile updated exactly N days ago is still returned.

grades.description: List of grades `id` to filter (described by /api/rest/application/dictionary/setting.typeOf.grade). The grade of a resource is the one carried by its ACTIVE HR contract - the last one started when several are active today - falling back to the most recent contract when none is active. Resources whose retained contract carries no grade match no value of this filter.

expertise_areas.description: List of expertise areas `id` to filter (described by /api/rest/application/dictionary/setting.expertiseArea)

The level `0` targets the tools whose level is not filled in on the technical data (for instance those filled in by resume parsing).

period.description: `working` : Resources assigned to deliveries between `startDate` and `endDate` are filtered excluding internal projects `workingAll` : Resources assigned to deliveries between `startDate` and `endDate` are filtered `absent` : Resources assigned to absence inactivity between `startDate` and `endDate` are filtered `idle` : Resources assigned to internal inactivity between `startDate` and `endDate` are filtered

period_actions.description: List of actions `id` (../bddboondmanager/classes/TAB_ACTION.html property_ACTION_TYPE described by /api/rest/application/dictionary/setting.action.resource = integer

period_dynamic.description: `today` : Resources filtered according to the grid for today's period `thisWeek` : Resources filtered according to the mesh for the period of this week `thisMonth` : Resources filtered according to the mesh for the period of this month `thisTrimester` : Resources filtered according to the mesh for the period of this trimester `thisSemester` : Resources filtered according to the mesh for the period of this semester

flags.description: Resources attached to this flag whom flag's unique identifier = integer are filtered

resource_states.description: List of resource states `id` to filter (described by /api/rest/application/dictionary/setting.state.resource)

encoding.description: If the output format is csv then encoding filter should be one of : `UTF-8` `ISO-8859-15` `WINDOWS-1250` `MAC-OS-ROMAN`

provider_companies.description: List of provider companies' `id` to filter

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates for proximity search, in the format `latitude,longitude`. Latitude must be in [-90, 90] and longitude must be in [-180, 180]. Must be used together with `geoDistance`.

location.description: Free-text address for geocoding-based proximity search (e.g. city name, address). The server will geocode this string to coordinates. Must be used together with `geoDistance`. If both `coordinates` and `location` are provided, `coordinates` takes priority.

geo_distance.description: Search radius in kilometers for proximity search. Required when using `coordinates` or `location`. Without this parameter, geo filters are ignored.

availability_status.description: List of availability status (only available for advanced/enterprise offers) `available` `partiallyAvailable` `soonAvailable` `soonInMission` `inMission` `unavailable`

availability_forecast.description: Variant of the `availability` sort (advanced/enterprise offers): `true` sorts on the forecast retained availability date (forecast deliveries included), `false` on the real one (signed deliveries only), matching the "Include forecast" switch of the resources list.

app_entity_fields.description: List of app entity responses filtered by ` _ : ` and with html characters encoded

shields.description: Filter resources by their shield status (conditional fields completion level): `uncomplete` : Required fields are missing `minimum` : Required fields OK, recommended fields missing `complete` : All conditional fields are filled
